13. (Currently Amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __wherein the contact elements are positioned to maintain both pneumatic gas flow through the first portion and electrical contact simultaneously__.

14. (Previously Presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

15. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is __permanently__ attachable to the flexible tube.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Previously Presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

18. (Previously Presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

19. (Previously Presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

20. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes __a separate__ pressure measuring tube connection.

21. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an integrated__ respiratory gas humidifier __positioned adjacent to the flexible tube__.

22. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via __a dedicated__ humidification line __separate from the gas passage__.

23. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a __rigid or semi-rigid__ tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

24. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a __non-conductive spirally reinforced plastic material__.

25. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is __an electrical resistance heating element integrated within the tube wall__.

26. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __and is positioned radially outward from the gas passage__ such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

27. (Currently Amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

28. (Previously Presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.

29. (Currently Amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __and is positioned radially outward from the gas passage__ such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

30. (Currently Amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

31. (Previously Presented) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.
